subject: Re: Evidence request — SDLC traceability & CI/CD change logs
messages:
From: Rachel Green <rachel.green@acme-payments.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — SDLC artifacts for SOC2 assessment

Hi Stephanie,

Acme's external assessor is working through the SDLC controls for our SOC 2 scoping and has asked for a compact set of artifacts showing traceability from requirements to code, CI/CD controls and change approvals for the last 12 months. At minimum they want:

- PR + code review policy excerpts and representative PRs (changes to production services)
- CI workflow definitions showing gating and automated tests
- Evidence of secrets handling (rotation schedules, KMS usage)
- Change approval records (who approved, timestamps), and a compact commit-to-deploy mapping

Can you confirm what we can share and provide a single archive or Drive link with a manifest? We prefer redacted examples where necessary, and a short narrative that maps each item to your internal control.

Thanks — can we get this by EOD Tuesday (2026-09-15)?

—Rachel
Rachel Green
Senior Security Assessor
Acme Payments

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Rachel Green <rachel.green@acme-payments.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SDLC artifacts for SOC2 assessment

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide a consolidated bundle. Couple of quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:

1) For "representative PRs" do you want only production-impacting services (yes) or also infra infra/ops repos?
2) For secrets evidence, is a summary (rotation cadence + KMS config screenshots + sample vault audit) acceptable, or do you need raw audit logs?
3) Any particular format you prefer for the commit-to-deploy mapping ("CSV is fine on our side").

We can deliver a zipped evidence bundle with a manifest, and include a short mapping doc that references specific files. Dev will prepare a commit traceability CSV and a filtered set of PR threads. We may need an extra day if you need raw logs.

I’ll coordinate and share a Drive link with access controls.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:18:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SDLC artifacts for SOC2 assessment

Stephanie / Laura —

Putting together the first pass. Outline and items attached:

Attachments:
- ci-workflows.zip (contains .github/workflows CI YAMLs with gating, test matrix, and required checks)
- commit-traceability.csv (columns: repo, pr_number, commit_sha, author, merged_at, deploy_tag, deploy_time)
- change-approval-audit.log (excerpts from our change-request service showing approver, timestamp, and change id)

What the bundle contains:
- PR/code-review policy excerpt (doc/policies/code_review.md) with our branch protection rules
- Sample PRs (redacted for customer data) from 3 production services — includes code review threads and approval timestamps
- CI/CD pipeline definitions and explanation of gating (see CI YAMLs)
- Secrets handling summary PDF (see secrets-rotation-summary.pdf) — note: raw Vault audit logs are not in the bundle, but we include an excerpt and rotation schedule plus KMS key policy screenshots

Notes on redaction: all PRs are scrubbed of customer PII/keys. If Acme requires raw logs for forensics we will need an approved data-sharing exception (we can provision time-limited access).

I’ll assemble a Drive folder and share link in the consolidated reply to Rachel.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform Infra
dev_patel@redwood.ai

From: Rachel Green <rachel.green@acme-payments.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:09:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SDLC artifacts for SOC2 assessment

Thanks for the quick turn. A couple follow-ups after a quick skim:

- The assessor asked for explicit evidence that secrets are not stored in repos (a grep summary or scan report is fine). Can you add an SBOM/scan output showing zero secrets detected in repo history for the supplied sample repos?
- For change approvals: we need a mapping from the change id in your change-approval-audit.log to the corresponding CI run id and deploy tag (so we can recreate the timeline). The CSV you sent has commit->deploy mapping; please ensure the change id is included.
- Finally, a short (1-page) narrative that maps each supplied artifact to the control it demonstrates (e.g., CC1: code review evidence — PR#1234, reviewer, approval time; CI1: gating — workflow name & link).

If you can update the bundle by EOD today (2026-09-15) that would keep us on schedule.

—Rachel

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Rachel Green <rachel.green@acme-payments.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SDLC artifacts for SOC2 assessment

Rachel —

Attached is a consolidated evidence bundle and a short mapping doc that addresses the assessor's follow-ups. Summary of what's included (files in Drive and attached ZIP):

- redwood-sdlc-evidence-bundle-20260915.zip (master archive)
- manifest.txt (human-readable index mapping artifacts to controls; included in root of ZIP)
- commit-traceability.csv (now includes change_id and ci_run_id columns for each mapped row)
- ci-workflows.zip (CI YAMLs and a short README describing gating checks)
- secrets-rotation-summary.pdf (rotation cadence, KMS key ARN screenshots)
- repo-secret-scan-results.txt (grep/scan summary showing no secrets found in selected repo history; scanner: internal-scan-v2)
- change-approval-audit.log (redacted approver emails; includes change_id -> approver -> timestamp)
- mapping-onepager.pdf (1-page narrative mapping files to control IDs)

Drive link (time-limited access, expires 2026-09-30): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLCEvidence
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.example.com/contacts/ACME-4982 (documented delivery)

If you need raw Vault audit logs or broader repo history, we can provide them via a secure transfer after an approved data-sharing form. Otherwise this bundle should meet the assessor's immediate needs. Please confirm receipt and whether the assessor needs anything further.

Thanks — will keep an eye for any redlines.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
